tasks.title: VERIFY: Phase 2
tasks.notes: Release x64 build: 0 errors. Offline tests: 7/7 pass. Integration tests: 6/6 pass vs 192.168.1.190. Fix: SslStreamTransportBindingElement (TASK-6) replaces HttpsTransportBindingElement, sends HTTP headers+body as single TLS record — fixes gSOAP 2.8 multi-record fragmentation crash. Also: Action mustUnderstand header stripped from outgoing requests; response mustUnderstand headers marked understood; FixUrl upgrades http:// xAddrs to https:// when session is HTTPS. Build fix: SslProtocols.Tls12 cast as enum<SslProtocols> 3072 for .NET 4.0 target framework compatibility; ExceptionDispatchInfo replaced with raise for .NET 4.0.

tasks.title: SslStreamTransportBindingElement replaces HttpsTransportBindingElement
tasks.notes: SslStreamTransport.fs added. Sends HTTP headers+body as a single TLS record via raw TcpClient+SslStream, bypassing .NET WCF HttpWebRequest multi-record fragmentation. Also strips Action mustUnderstand header (gSOAP returns HTTP 500 fault) and marks response mustUnderstand headers as understood. Done as part of VERIFY-2 fix.
